def factor_volume_breakout_log(df):
    """Volume breakout with log normalization: log of the ratio of recent max volume to wider max volume."""
    df_copy = df.copy()
    vol_short_max = df_copy["volume"].rolling(window=10, min_periods=10).max()
    vol_long_max = df_copy["volume"].rolling(window=50, min_periods=50).max()
    ratio = vol_short_max / vol_long_max.replace(0, np.nan)
    log_ratio = np.log(ratio.clip(lower=1e-12))
    df_copy["factor_volume_breakout_log"] = log_ratio
    return df_copy["factor_volume_breakout_log"]
description: Mutation of factor_volume_breakout: preserves the core volume surge detection via max ratio, but applies a logarithmic transformation to the ratio. The log transform normalizes the distribution, potentially improving linear predictability (IC) by reducing the impact of extreme ratio values while retaining the relative rank ordering of volume abnormalities. The transformation is a lightweight modifier that enhances interpretability and robustness.
